_how_to_edit: Each animal is one entry. status is one of: available, reserved, sold. photo is a file name in assets/img (leave empty if none). Lists can be empty; the page then shows a waitlist message. past_litter_photos is a gallery of puppies from earlier litters: each has a photo (file name in assets/img) and alt (a short description). planned_litters lists upcoming breedings: sire and dam must match names in gampr_parents; timing (e.g. "Expected spring 2027") and note are optional. Empty the list once the litter is born. Each gampr_parents entry also drives that dog's own page at /dogs/<slug>/: registered_name, born (YYYY-MM-DD), summary, health, embark/ofa/agca links (leave empty to hide), gallery, and pedigree (sire/dam, each with name, optional reg, and their own sire/dam).
